scope: Nineteen Wave4 source-kit locks propagated into playable character arcs. Public evidence contains canonical metadata and hashes only.
historicalEvidencePolicy: Historical generation records are read locally only to compare immutable hashes. No historical prompt text, generation identifiers, absolute paths or local reference paths are published in this report.
sourceReviewLimits: Source-data corrections and typed game effects do not certify sprite resemblance, exact source choreography, disarm/stun/infection mechanics or the unresolved composite stage continuity.
